name: Fuobe timelapse

dataset.what: Own time-lapse and hyperlapse clips: skies, streets, people holding still while the world moves.
captions: Every caption starts with "fbtimelapse, " then says "time-lapse" (or "hyperlapse" when the camera travels) in the same words each time, then what is in the first frame.
One sentence for what moves and one for what stays still; no text, logos or names.

notes: Replaces the Wan 2.2 Time-lapse LoRA, which forbids selling outputs.
